opportunities.title: SSHole: The OpenSSH Bug That Went From Patch to Pwn in Hours
opportunities.why_now: OpenSSH rushed an emergency fix for the SSHole auth bypass and attackers were already rooting honeypots within hours of disclosure, plus a parallel musl/Alpine bug lets a long enough password skip auth entirely.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence timeline piece: disclosure clock vs exploit clock, with a 'patch now' checklist for both the SSHole bypass and the musl password-length bug

opportunities.title: DigiCert Sat on a Breach for 16 Months — Here's Why That Should Terrify You
opportunities.why_now: DigiCert, a root CA trusted to vouch for the internet's identity, just admitted customer data was exposed for over a year before anyone noticed.
opportunities.angle: Breach-digest deep dive on detection failure at a trust anchor, with a timeline graphic and 'what DigiCert customers should do now' sidebar

opportunities.title: Chainalysis Got Hacked — Yes, the Company Crypto Cops Use to Catch Hackers
opportunities.why_now: A breach at Chainalysis exposed all user credentials and forced a shutdown of key services, a brutal irony for a firm built to track illicit crypto flows.
opportunities.angle: Ironic-breach feature: 'who watches the watchmen' angle plus practical guidance for Chainalysis customers on credential rotation

opportunities.title: 1,122 GitHub Repos Are Leaking Secrets Because of Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' Button
opportunities.why_now: Researchers found over a thousand public repos exposing passwords and API keys due to a permissive AI coding assistant setting, a fresh twist on the secrets-in-git problem.
opportunities.angle: AI-assisted-dev security explainer: how the setting works, why devs keep shipping it public, and a quick grep/detection recipe for readers to check their own repos

opportunities.title: The Freezer Hacking Spree: How One ICS Bug Took Down Grocers on Two Continents
opportunities.why_now: Feds are warning US grocers while Europe is already counting the damage from a refrigeration-controller hacking spree, with Ahold Delhaize now tallying the financial toll — a rare OT breach with a clear before/after cost.
opportunities.angle: Cross-report roundup tying US CISA warning + European spread + Ahold Delhaize's dollar figures into one 'this is what unpatched ICS costs' digest
